review_input.original_instruction: You will start by facing an open doorway. Turn around and you will see a hallway. Walk towards the hallway where there's a painting on the wall. Once you're there, on your right you will see the kitchen. Turn to your right and walk straight down. Standing in between the sink and the stove. Continue walking forward until you've reached the dining table. Once you're at the dining table, you will see on the right. There's a painting on the wall and another hallway on the right. Walk towards the hallway and when you're there, you will see a room. Walk inside the room. AS you can see there's a couch with purple or black cushions and the bed. Walk towards the right side of the bed and when you're at the right side of the bed, you will see on the right an open door. Walk inside the washroom, Standing at the right side of the bathtub. Keep walking all the way to the closet. Once you're in front of the closet, on your right you will see an area where it's all decorated with tiles. Small tiles. Walk inside that area and as you can see now in front of you is a shower area with black shower head and shower hose. Take another step forward until you're right underneath the shower head. Once you're there, you're done.
